categories.main_business_segments: Actions Technology Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, design, and sales of mid-to-high-end intelligent audio SoC chips. Its main product lines include smart wireless audio SoC chips, edge AI processor chips, and portable audio-video SoC chips, serving applications such as Bluetooth speakers, wireless home theater systems, smartwatches, AI glasses, wireless microphones, and gaming headsets. The company operates mainly in the AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) domain, targeting wireless audio, smart wearables, and intelligent interaction devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chip design technologies including a tri-core heterogeneous architecture combining CPU, DSP, and NPU, with a focus on low power consumption and high computing power. It innovatively uses analog-digital hybrid SRAM-based Computing in Memory (CIM) technology for AI acceleration, enabling high energy efficiency and performance. The firm also develops proprietary Bluetooth and 2.4G private wireless communication protocols, high-performance audio ADC/DAC technologies, and advanced audio DSP algorithms for low latency and high-quality sound. Manufacturing follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and service providers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading domestic and international first-tier brands in consumer electronics, including major players in Bluetooth speakers, smart wearables, and wireless audio devices. Key customers include brands like Harman, Bose, LG, Sony, Xiaomi, and others, as well as ODM/OEM manufacturers. Its products are widely used in smart audio devices, wireless home theaters, gaming headsets, AI glasses, and IoT smart terminals, targeting both domestic and global markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Zhuhai, China, with subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Hefei. Its market coverage includes both domestic China and international regions, with significant sales and customer penetration in overseas markets. Approximately 41% of revenue is generated from overseas markets, reflecting a broad geographic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Actions Technology operates as a fabless semiconductor design company, focusing on chip design and development. It relies on upstream wafer foundries and packaging/testing service providers for manufacturing and assembly, positioning itself in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain. The company also provides integrated software development platforms and solutions to downstream customers, enhancing its role in the value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically prioritizes R&D investment in low-power, high-performance AIoT chips, especially edge AI processors with integrated AI accelerators based on CIM technology. It focuses on advancing wireless communication technologies including Bluetooth 5.4, LE Audio, 2.4G private protocols, UWB, WiFi, and emerging standards. Continuous innovation in audio signal processing, low latency, and high fidelity audio codecs is emphasized. The firm also invests in expanding AI capabilities on edge devices, developing AI development tools, and enhancing product integration to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit chips (SoC products) to brand customers and ODM/OEM manufacturers. The company employs a buyout sales model dominated by distribution channels, supplemented by direct sales. Additionally, it offers comprehensive hardware-software integrated solutions, including software development kits and application platforms, to facilitate customer product development and adoption.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in the mid-to-high-end intelligent audio SoC chip market, with significant penetration in international first-tier brand supply chains. It competes with global semiconductor firms in wireless audio and AIoT chip segments, leveraging proprietary technologies and strong R&D capabilities. Its competitive advantages include advanced AI integration, low power consumption, and customized wireless communication protocols. The firm has been recognized with multiple industry awards and certifications, reinforcing its market standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 651.9 million, representing a 25.34% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 106.6 million, a 63.83% increase from the previous year. R&D expenses accounted for 33% of revenue, reflecting strong investment in innovation. The company’s total assets grew by 12.22% to RMB 2.16 billion, and net assets increased by 3.85% to RMB 1.88 billion. The firm demonstrates a robust growth trajectory with expanding market share and profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Actions Technology emphasizes delivering high-quality, low-power, and high-performance AIoT chips with integrated AI acceleration, enabling advanced edge AI applications. Its proprietary CIM-based NPU technology offers superior energy efficiency and computing power, differentiating its products in the market. The company’s deep expertise in audio signal processing and wireless communication protocols ensures low latency and high-fidelity audio experiences. By providing integrated hardware-software solutions and maintaining close partnerships with leading global brands, it offers customized, high-value products that meet stringent performance and reliability requirements.
